title: Server-side session survives application logout
vulnerable_behaviour: Logout responds 200 and expires the browser cookie but the server-side session record is never deleted; a copy of the cookie value keeps working.
fixed_behaviour: Logout deletes the server-side session record before expiring the cookie.
termination_trigger: explicit application logout: GET RP1 /logout?federated=0 (200, logged_out=true)
declared_expected_scope: the RP1 server-side session presented by the cookie
protected_operation: GET RP1 /profile with the pre-logout rp_sid cookie
cwe_rule_path: => explicit-termination failure (CWE-613 usage-B sense: session not invalidated on logout)

neighbour_rules.CWE-613 original sense (time-only expira: not matched: an explicit trigger exists
neighbour_rules.CWE-384 session fixation: not matched: the identifier is not reused across a login boundary

uncertainty.reason: single component, single hop; the trace shows the same cookie accepted before and after a 200 logout

lifecycle_event: explicit application logout: GET RP1 /logout?federated=0 (200, logged_out=true)
normative_basis: Declared local-logout contract, consistent with the cited session-termination guidance.
